verdict.rationale: Bevy's docs claim one codebase targets Windows, macOS, Linux, Web, iOS and Android, and a community report says it runs well on iOS, so the desktop and mobile parts of the story are covered. Nothing in the evidence mentions console export, either direct or through partners, and that is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of console export (direct or via partners), detailed first-party docs on the mobile build/export workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of Android and desktop shipping.
